[color=#6fa8dc][size=4][b]Installation instructions:[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#cc4125][b]!PORTRAITURE MOD IS REQUIRED![/b][/color]
[color=#ffffff]1. Download Portraiture: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999[/url] , unzip it and put it on your mods folder.[/color]
2. Download the portrait i made.
3. Make a folder on  [b]"Mods/Portraiture/Portraits" that you name however you like. [/b]for ex. "My Portraits".
4. Unzip Huwa's bachelorette portraits, put the png files in the "My portraits" folder.
5. Start the game, talk to a character, and then press "P" or whatever keybind you have it.

[color=#6d9eeb][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]All of the base game bachelorette portraits, Regular and beach portraits. i will make the winter outfits after i finish all of the bachelors portrait. also planning to make the non-romanceable villagers soon..[/color]
